 Anselm Noronha

 East Bengal face North Korean team April 25 in their last group B match of the 2026-27 AFC Women’s Champions League in Kolkata on Saturday.
 The Moshal Girls started with a 2-1 win over Ho Chi Minh City WFC, but went on to suffer a 4-1 defeat against Hwacheon KSPO. With three points at stake, East Bengal will aim for a positive result that can take them to the quarters.

 On the other hand, April 25 won both their matches with victories over Hwacheon KSPO 2-1 and Ho Chi Minh City WFC 6-0. They have already secured their qualification and are aiming to extend their winning streak.
 Uganda’s Fazila Ikwaput has scored all three goals of East Bengal thus far in the tournament. A draw is enough for the Indian side to progress to the next round.

 East Bengal vs. April 25   live stream, TV channel 
 Here's how to watch East Bengal vs. April 25 AFC Women's Champions League match in India:
 TV channel: N/A
 Live stream: FanCode
 This game is not available for live TV broadcast in India. However, fans can live stream the action through FanCode app and website.
 MORE:   India vs. New Zealand schedule, squads ahead of football friendlies 
 What time does East Bengal vs. April 25   kick off? 
 The AFC Women's Champions League between East Bengal and April 25 will be played at Kishore Bharati Krirangan (Kishore Bharati Stadium) in Kolkata.
 It will kick off at 8:00 p.m. on Saturday, November 7 , in India.
